title: Used In and Uses
responsibility: Shows what uses an entity and what that entity uses.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.relations
inputs.description: Required relationship data organized by the usage helper.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.nav
inputs.description: Required route context for related-entity links.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.show
inputs.description: Optional both, used-in or uses, default both. Selects which sections appear.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.compact
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default. True hides purpose text while keeping names and badges.

inputs.name: EntityRelations.removed
inputs.description: Optional flag, false by default, changing empty-state wording to explain removal at this commit.

outputs.name: EntityRelations
outputs.description: Counted Used In list and categorized Uses groups without verification marks. Changed or added entities receive Changed badges. Unknown-category others remain unlinked. Empty sections explain missing records; removed mode does not substitute old relationships.
